original_test_intent: Verify all expected AMD GPUs enumerate, PCIe and XGMI links are healthy, amdgpu sees every device and UBB/OAM firmware, health and telemetry show no unexplained error.
original_method: Agent runs exact approved read-only in-band commands and collects complete outputs; operator/user supplies and supervises the vendor UBB/OAM OOB procedure and acceptance matrix.
manual_activity: User supplies expected topology/count, tool versions and vendor OOB procedure/access; operator supervises OOB collection and reviews the complete comparison.
required_inputs: Expected AMD GPU count, PCI IDs, BDF/retimer and XGMI topology
Referenced UBB firmware-info, UBB/OAM health and all-sensor telemetry procedure
Expected PCIe/XGMI/driver/health/telemetry values and error policy
Secure in-band/OOB access and protected evidence storage
safety_requirements: Verify host, topology, IDs and tool versions before collection
Keep all actions read-only and preserve baseline logs
Do not infer firmware update from the reference or load/reset devices without approval
Stop on count mismatch, link down/unknown, driver error, UBB/OAM/telemetry fault, thermal/power/kernel/BMC issue
Do not embed secrets or clear evidence
agent_execution_scope: Run exact lspci count/link, amdxio XGMI and amd-smi list checks
Collect vendor-approved UBB/OAM firmware, health and telemetry outputs
Correlate every device/link/sensor to the approved topology
Do not hard-code count, update firmware, reset GPU/link, decide missing expectations or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Resolve missing/ambiguous device, link or sensor data
Review complete cross-layer evidence and decide PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic rocm-smi and accelerator counts cover only part of enumeration and do not implement the source's exact PCI ID, retimer link, XGMI, amd-smi or OOB checks.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use exact lspci -d 1002:75a0 count, lspci -d 1022:1500 LnkSta, amdxio XGMI and amd-smi list, followed by the pinned vendor OOB collection.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All in-band count/link/XGMI/driver and referenced OOB UBB/OAM steps plus source 5/5 timing are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a cross-layer matrix from PCI GPU/retimer identities through XGMI and driver devices to UBB/OAM firmware, health and sensors.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact expected inputs and traceability without changing the source read-only diagnostics.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No OOB or link domain is dropped in favor of a partial device count.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Tool and PCI IDs are platform-generation specific; an unapproved driver load may itself change availability.

project_override_considerations: Project authority must supply the actual expected count/topology and referenced OOB procedures; DeepSeek's eight-device assumption and generic accelerator class are not authoritative.
expected_evidence: Approved topology/count/PCI IDs and tool versions
Exact GPU count and per-BDF PCIe link status
Complete XGMI link matrix and amd-smi device/driver visibility
UBB firmware inventory and UBB/OAM health results
Command status/timestamps, OS/BMC/SEL/thermal/power logs, comparison and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure consistently defines a broad combined in-band/OOB AMD GPU health check; missing expected count and referenced packages are readiness inputs, not conflicting source text.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Topology, packages, OOB procedure and access are supplyable prerequisites; static review is complete.

review_improvement: Restores omitted PCIe/XGMI/driver/OOB coverage and removes an unsupported hard-coded count and unsafe access path.
independent_technical_reasoning: Matching GPU counts at PCI and driver layers can still hide a down-trained PCIe link, broken XGMI path or unhealthy OAM sensor. Conversely, an OOB inventory alone cannot prove the OS driver binds every GPU. A valid result therefore requires a one-to-one topology correlation across PCIe, XGMI, amd-smi and UBB/OAM telemetry.
